candidates.requirement: Enable built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE reception and advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so the server receiver can process a valid PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a server, submits SETTINGS, then passes input to nghttp2_session_mem_recv. A valid client preface, initial SETTINGS, and PRIORITY_UPDATE frame should reach session_process_priority_update_frame.
candidates.failure_condition: The null-option session has a zero built-in extension mask. Its sole submitted setting is MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS, which sets pending_no_rfc7540_priorities to 0. The receiver therefore ignores PRIORITY_UPDATE before unpacking, updating a stream, or calling the frame callback.
candidates.alternative_paths: Peer SETTINGS changes remote settings, not the pending local setting. The user-extension route also requires an option and unpack callback absent from the complete harness. Raw input cannot change either setup.

candidates.requirement: Advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so received request Priority fields can set extensible priority and apply it to the stream.
candidates.target_route: A valid client preface, SETTINGS, and HPACK-encoded request HEADERS containing a valid Priority field enter mem_recv, header inflation, http_request_on_header, and session_end_stream_headers_received.
candidates.failure_condition: The harness submits only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS, leaving pending_no_rfc7540_priorities at 0. Opened request streams lack NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES, so the Priority field cannot set the new flag or apply its parsed value.
candidates.alternative_paths: A peer SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES value changes remote settings only. Neither natural request bytes nor the harness’s other calls submit the required local setting; the legacy PRIORITY frame does not apply the request Priority field contract.
